body: research/TASK_U11.md. R68 landed 2026-09-08: a belt now names the promotion that sanctions it, and GameState.get_promotions_read() gives every promotion most-popular-first with tier, reputation and a 1-based rank. The CHAMPIONS board reads it; the promotions board does not, so the relationship is one-way. Put the belts on PromotionsBoard.org_row(), read them ONCE in read_all() and never per row - a read inside org_row is a call per promotion, which is the exact defect R68 just spent a stage removing. Also collapse sort_by_standing_in_sport() and WorldPopulation.promotions_by_standing() into one order. R69 runs at the same time and the owned files are disjoint: you have PromotionsBoard.gd plus OfficeHubPanel.gd and ScheduleHubPanel.gd and their three tests; I have GameState.gd, ChampionshipRead.gd, WorldPopulation.gd, ProfileRevampPanel.gd, FightContractScreen.gd and RankingsHubPanel.gd. If you think you need a new read, send mail and stop rather than adding one. Suite gate is fails=0 OR BETTER - if it comes back lower than expected say so and push anyway. One more thing: push to master, not to a branch. U3, U5 and U8 were all pushed to cursor/* branches where inbox could not see the reports; two sat unread for a day and one carried a live defect found only on 2026-09-08.
